visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a montage of a young man with short black hair wearing a light-blue denim jacket over a white t-shirt. He is seen waving enthusiastically at the camera in a modern hotel room and later lying on a white bed with his arms spread wide. The room features dark wood-paneled walls and warm lighting. (2) The scene shifts to a bright indoor environment where the man is shown in a close-up, tearing open a piece of crusty bread filled with a bright orange mentaiko paste. He has an excited expression. This is followed by a shot of his hand holding a plastic cup of iced coffee against a plain wall. (3) The man is then shown outdoors at night in front of a modern building facade featuring horizontal yellow light strips. He performs a brief energetic dance and points towards a nearby subway station entrance marked with the letter 'F' and the word 'Subway'. A few female pedestrians are visible walking in the background. (4) Returning to the hotel interior, the man demonstrates the self-check-in kiosk on a wooden counter. He walks through a very dark, narrow corridor with red carpeting and black walls. (5) Inside the room, he shows a small open closet area. He then sits on the floor to demonstrate how a pink suitcase fits into a designated storage space directly underneath the bed frame. (6) Visual details of the room are shown: a small refrigerator tucked under a desk, various neatly arranged towels and amenities on shelves, and a compact bathroom featuring a white sink, toilet, and shower with a curved layout. (7) A shot from the room's window shows a city street at night with a 'GO CANAL' sign and cars passing by. The video ends with the man back in the room, waving to the camera as brand information and contact details appear in a text overlay.

A male voice enters immediately with a high-pitched, enthusiastic tone, speaking rapidly. A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies the first visual transition. (2) The music continues at a consistent volume while the speaker describes food; a subtle rustling sound of paper or plastic is briefly audible during the bread-tearing scene. (3) As the location transitions to the outdoors, a very faint ambient urban hum is present beneath the loud music and the speaker's energetic narration. (4) Frequent 'pop' and 'swish' sound effects are used to punctuate each new room feature being shown, such as the closet or the storage space under the bed. The speaker maintains a professional yet highly excited vocal delivery throughout. (5) The video concludes with the speaker's final call to action, with the background music sustaining its energy until a quick fade-out and a final ringing sound effect at the very end.
